definitions.explanation: A naturally elevated area of land. Often mentioned in the context of scenic views, residential areas, or evacuation sites during disasters.

examples.japanese: {高台|たかだい}から{町|まち}を{見下|みお}ろす。
examples.english: Look down on the town from the hilltop.

examples.japanese: {高台|たかだい}に{建|た}つ{家|いえ}は{眺|なが}めがいい。
examples.english: Houses built on elevated ground have good views.

examples.japanese: {津波|つなみ}{警報|けいほう}が{出|で}たら、すぐに{高台|たかだい}に{避難|ひなん}してください。
examples.english: If a tsunami warning is issued, evacuate to high ground immediately.

notes:
Frequently appears in disaster preparedness contexts, especially for tsunami evacuation. After the 2011 {東日本|ひがしにほん}{大震災|だいしんさい}, {高台|たかだい}に{避難|ひなん} (evacuate to high ground) became widely known.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高台|たかだい}に{避難|ひなん}する (evacuate to high ground)
- {高台|たかだい}に{建|た}つ (built on elevated ground)
- {高台|たかだい}から{見下|みお}ろす (look down from high ground)
- {高台|たかだい}の{住宅地|じゅうたくち} (residential area on high ground)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {丘|おか} refers to a hill as a landform
- {高台|たかだい} emphasizes the elevated position relative to surroundings
